description: I'm currently a research and development technician at ITI, based in 🌇 Valencia. I am working on some side projects, navigating 🚢 between the balance of work ⚙️ and conquering fascinating coding side endeavors 🧑‍💻.
iti-job-description:
- Part of the Zero Gravity research team.
- Technical researcher developing high tech solutions that involve visual inspection systems using artificial intelligence (AI).
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate visual inspection systems into existing products and processes.
- Write technical reports and documents to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
- Participate in industry conferences and events to network and learn about new technologies and research trends.
dial-job-description:
- DialApplet full stack software development using PostgreSQL for BD engine, PHP, Javascript, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS3 for web frontend and C++ and Qt for backend.
 - Manage and maintain DialApplet's Linux system.
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure software integration and functionality.
 - Identify and troubleshoot software issues and bugs.
 - Participate in code reviews and provide guidance to junior team members.
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of DialApplet's software development processes.
collimator-description: Collimator is a software for easy telescope collimation on Linux. It provides an intuitive interface to guide users through the process of aligning the telescope’s optical components for optimal performance. With real-time feedback, Collimator simplifies adjustments for telescope lens, ensuring clearer and sharper astronomical observations.
